description: The chart illustrates “Popularity” values for three category groups—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—shown as clustered bars for three models (Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow) and further subdivided by three answer/accuracy conditions indicated by bar hatch patterns. The horizontal axis contains the categories Movies, Songs, and Basketball in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Popularity” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 20-unit intervals from about 20 up to 220. Within each category cluster, there are nine bars arranged by model color (blue, red, yellow) and pattern: a dotted/mesh-like hatch for “Acc=0 & GT Ans,” a diagonal hatch for “Acc=0 & Gene Ans,” and an unhatched solid fill for “Acc=1 & GT Ans,” as indicated by the legend. For Movies, the blue Llama3 bars are approximately ~25 (Acc=0 & GT Ans), ~35 (Acc=0 & Gene Ans), and ~40 (Acc=1 & GT Ans); the red Qwen2 bars are about ~28, ~40, and ~45; and the yellow ChatGPT bars are about ~25, ~28, and ~35. For Songs, the blue Llama3 bars are about ~58, ~48, and ~72; the red Qwen2 bars are about ~55, ~65, and ~85; and the yellow ChatGPT bars are about ~45, ~52, and ~73. For Basketball, the blue Llama3 bars are about ~100, ~155, and ~178; the red Qwen2 bars are about ~100, ~188, and ~212; and the yellow ChatGPT bars are about ~98, ~170, and ~138. The bars are not presented as a single sorted sequence across categories; instead, they are grouped by category with consistent color/pattern encoding, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the use of the legend-defined colors and hatch styles.
